text: SOGAZ has no state majority: per its January 2020 shareholder disclosure the largest shareholder is the Kovalchuk family (32.3% via Aquilla); state-controlled bank VTB received 10% of SOGAZ and a board seat in the 2018 merger of VTB Strakhovanie into SOGAZ (held via Kordex in the January 2020 list).
short: SOGAZ: no state majority; VTB got 10% and a board seat in 2018.

source.name: Forbes.Россия: Загадка «Согаза»: кого, кроме миллиардера Ковальчука и двоюродного племянника Путина, обогатил страховщик «Газпрома» (archived copy)
source.quote: ВТБ получил 10% в компании и место в совете директоров
source.note: Translation: 'VTB received 10% in the company and a seat on the board of directors' (in the VTB Strakhovanie – SOGAZ merger). SOGAZ's own January 2020 shareholder list is an image-only PDF; the figures it shows are relayed by The Bell.

additionalSources.name: The Bell (thebell.io): Выходец из спецназа ФСБ оказался владельцем 5% акций «Согаза» на $440 млн (archived copy)
additionalSources.quote: Крупнейшие акционеры «Согаза» (32,3%) — совладелец банка «Россия», друг Владимира Путина Юрий Ковальчук, его родственники и топ-менеджеры банка.
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'The largest shareholders of SOGAZ (32.3%) are Yuri Kovalchuk, co-owner of Bank Rossiya and a friend of Vladimir Putin, his relatives and the bank's top managers.' Written from SOGAZ's January 2020 disclosure.
